account.noAvatar: Sonarium stores no pictures of you, and fetches none from anywhere else.
account.passwordIntro: Changing it signs you out everywhere else.
account.changed: Your password has been changed. Every other sign-in has ended.
account.wrongPassword: That is not your current password.

sessions.title: Where you are signed in
sessions.intro: Every device holding a sign-in for this account.
sessions.revokeOthersConfirm: Sign out of every device except this one?
sessions.revokeOthersBody_one: {{count}} other sign-in ends. Nothing is deleted, and you stay signed in here.
sessions.revokeOthersBody_other: {{count}} other sign-ins end. Nothing is deleted, and you stay signed in here.
sessions.error: Your sign-ins could not be read.

appearance.themeHint: Saved on this device, because it is a property of the screen you are looking at.
appearance.languageHint: English is the only language this version speaks. It is saved to your account.

administration.title: This instance
administration.intro: These settings belong to the whole instance and to everybody with an account on it, not to you.

users.title: Accounts
users.intro: Accounts are made here, by hand, for people you know. There is no sign-up page.
users.name: Display name
users.makeAdminHint: Administrators see this section and everything in it.
users.createFailed: The account could not be created.

provider.title: Transcription
provider.intro: Where recordings are sent to be transcribed, and whether that is off this machine.
provider.name: Provider
provider.neverAutomatic: Nothing is contacted until you press this. Opening this page reaches out to nobody.
provider.unconfigured: No provider is set up, so nothing on this instance can be transcribed. Set SONARIUM_TRANSCRIPTION_* in the environment and restart.

queue.title: Background work
queue.intro: Probing, waveforms, transcoding and transcription. Newest first, because the reason to look is that something just went wrong.
queue.tooMany: Showing the newest {{shown}} of {{total}}. The counts above are the whole queue.

empty.title: Everything asked for has been done
empty.body: Nothing is waiting, running or failed.

mismatch.title: The database is not where this build expects it
mismatch.body: Writes may fail or lose data until the migrations have run. Run them, or go back to the image that matches this database.
